requirements_summary: Primary: embeddings for semantic search across product docs + customer conversations. Targets: <50ms median embedding latency, 95th percentile search latency <120ms at 100 qps read traffic. Nightly batch ETL: 5M doc updates/day (embedding generation + upsert). Must support vector DB integration (Pinecone or pgvector) and run incremental refreshes. Data residency: US only. SSO + audit logging required for audit trail.
throughput_targets: Embedding API: sustain 200 qps peak for short bursts, steady-state 60 qps. Search queries: 100 qps with p95 <120ms. Batch throughput: generate and ingest 5M embeddings in a 6 hour window (approx 230k embeddings/hour).
batch_jobs_requirements: ETL runs nightly in cloud (GCP). Needs cost estimate for token compute and egress. Prefer serverless batch runner but open to Redwood-scheduled jobs. Want auto-retry, idempotent upserts, and partial-failure visibility in Console.
poc_summary: Running hosted API POC against a 50k doc subset - initial embedding quality OK vs baseline (weaviate local test). SE to run dedicated load test simulating 1M vector index + 100 qps search to validate latency. Key success metrics: embedding quality parity with baseline, search p95 <120ms, predictable cost per 1M vectors/day.
